name: BOGO & Free Gift Coupons for WooCommerce — DC BOGO
author: Dipak Chaudhari

sections.description:
DC BOGO Coupons is the most intuitive and powerful solution for creating advanced BOGO coupons for WooCommerce, automatic free gift coupon deals, and buy-one-get-one promotions. Whether you want to set up a classic “Buy One Get One Free”, offer an automatic free gift with purchase, or create targeted category discounts, the DC BOGO coupon plugin delivers enterprise-grade coupon rules completely free.

Unlike other WooCommerce BOGO plugins, DC BOGO Coupons includes category-based BOGO rules and category discount offers completely free — a feature that others charge premium prices for!

Why Choose DC BOGO Coupons for WooCommerce?

  • Category BOGO Included Free — Create “Buy from Category A, Get Product B” offers without paying for premium add-ons.
  • Auto-Add Free Gift Coupon Items — Auto-adds free items and promotional gifts directly to cart; no manual customer selection needed.
  • Smart & Flexible Rules — Works seamlessly with simple products, product categories, and variable products.
  • Dynamic Cart Reminders — Shows specific product names (e.g., “Add 1 more Knit Towel to unlock your free gift!”) instead of generic cart messages.
  • Conversion-Driven UX — Clean admin interface, real-time progress bars, and instant cart totals updates.

Powerful BOGO Coupon & Free Gift Features

Flexible BOGO Coupon Rule Types:
* Buy X Get Y (Different Products BOGO) — Buy Product A, get Product B free or at a discount.
* Buy X Get X (Same Product BOGO) — Classic Buy 1 Get 1 Free, Buy 2 Get 1, Buy 3 Get 2.
* Category BOGO Coupon Rules — Buy from Category A, get a specific product or item from Category B.
* Buy Specific Product, Get from Category — E.g., Buy a Coffee Maker, get any Mug at 50% off.
* Buy from Category A, Get from Category B — Completely free category-to-category BOGO rules.

Discount & Free Gift Options:
* Free Gift (100% Discount) — Give away complimentary gifts with purchase.
* Percentage BOGO Discounts — E.g., Buy 1, Get 2nd at 50% off.
* Fixed Amount Discounts — E.g., Buy 1, Get $10 off another item.
* Cheapest Item First Calculation — Smart price calculation automatically applies discount to the lowest-priced eligible item.

Auto-Add Free Gift Functionality:
* Automatically add free gift items to cart when qualifying products are added.
* Supports both simple and variable products (with variation selection).
* Smart stock verification before adding free items to prevent overselling.
* Smart quantity management ensuring customers get exact promotional counts.
* Automatic removal of free gifts when qualifying cart items are removed.

Advanced Conversion Features:
* Repeatable Offers — Scale deals automatically: Buy 1 Get 1, Buy 2 Get 2, Buy 3 Get 3, etc.
* Usage & Customer Limits — Set total campaign limits and per-customer limits.
* Date Scheduling — Schedule start and end dates for holiday promotions and flash sales.
* User Role Targeting — Restrict exclusive BOGO coupon offers to VIPs, wholesalers, or subscribers.
* Smart Cart Notices — Inform shoppers with dynamic notices of how many more items they need to qualify for a free gift coupon.
* Visual Progress Bar — Visual cart progress bar motivating customers to increase average order value.
* Coupon Code or Automatic Application — Run automatic deals or require a coupon code at checkout.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dc-bogo-coupons directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Marketing > BOGO Coupons to create your first offer!
sections.faq:
How do I create a BOGO coupon in WooCommerce?

Navigate to Marketing > BOGO Coupons in your WordPress dashboard, click Add New Rule, configure your “Buy” condition (choose specific products or categories) and your “Get” reward (set discount percentage or 100% free gift), and hit Publish.

Can I create a free gift coupon or gift with purchase offer?

Yes! DC BOGO Coupons lets you set up automatic free gifts when a customer buys a qualifying product or category, or require a coupon code at checkout for special gift-with-purchase campaigns.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes! You can select specific variations or the parent product for both buy rules and free gift rewards.

Can I limit the offer to specific user roles?

Yes, you can restrict offers to specific user roles like ‘Customer’, ‘Subscriber’, or custom roles.

Does it support coupon codes?

Yes, you can choose to apply the BOGO offer automatically or require a WooCommerce coupon code.

Are category-based BOGO rules really free?

Yes! Category-based BOGO rules and category discounts are completely free and included out of the box in the DC BOGO coupon plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.1.7

  • Feature: Added dedicated developer support, custom work inquiry, and donation links to admin settings and rule editor.
  • Feature: Added non-intrusive, timed review prompt for active store managers to leave WordPress.org feedback.
  • Improvement: Added quick plugin action and row meta links (Settings, Support, Hire Developer, Rate ★★★★★).
  • Improvement: Updated documentation with direct developer support channels.

1.1.6

  • Improvement: Enhanced plugin discovery and SEO metadata for WooCommerce BOGO and free gift coupon searches.
  • Improvement: Verified and updated compatibility with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.2.
  • Improvement: Optimized cart notice messaging for free gift qualification and BOGO deals.
  • Tweak: Documentation and tags optimization aligned with WordPress.org guidelines.

1.1.5

  • Fix: Resolved critical activation error where main plugin class was missing during activation hook.

1.1.4

  • Security: Added nonce verification and rate limiting to the frontend progress AJAX endpoint.
  • Improvement: Cached active BOGO rule lookups to reduce database load on cart pages.
  • Improvement: Improved free gift and BOGO offer discoverability with expanded search keywords.
  • Improvement: Updated WordPress compatibility to 7.0.

1.1.3

  • Fix: Refactored admin code to remove raw script/style tags for better compliance.
  • Fix: Moved plugin assets to correct directory structure.
  • Improvement: Updated plugin icon path.

1.1.2

  • Fix: Resolved admin UI glitches where “Get” fields were not clearing correctly when switching rule types.
  • Fix: Improved “Get” field disabling logic to prevent selecting conflicting items.
  • Fix: Added auto-clear functionality for “Get” fields when “Buy” selection changes in “Different Items” mode.
  • Fix: Resolved issue with “Specific Products” (AJAX) allowing selection of conflicting items.

1.1.1

  • Fix: Resolved critical bug where auto-added items were being removed incorrectly when cart quantity decreased.
  • Fix: Fixed issue where auto-added items were not receiving the correct discount (free/percentage).
  • Improvement: Enhanced cart reminder messages to show specific product names instead of generic text.

1.1.0

  • New: Added visual progress bar for cart totals.
  • Improvement: Refined auto-add logic for better performance.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
